summary:
bash: set -e
getent passwd nobody daemon | cut -d: -f1,3
bash --version | head -1 >/dev/null
echo "=== create probe tree as alice (strict umask 077) ==="
su -s /bin/sh alice -c 'umask 077; mkdir /srv/shared/probe; echo hi > /srv/shared/probe/alice.txt'
su -s /bin/sh bob   -c 'umask 077; echo yo > /srv/shared/probe/bob.txt'
echo "=== stat of probe dir and files ==="
stat -c '%A %a %U:%G %n' /srv/shared/probe /srv/shared/probe/*
echo "=== acl on probe dir ==="
getfacl -p /srv/shared/probe
echo "=== acl on alice.txt ==="
getfacl -p /srv/shared/probe/alice.txt
echo "=== cross-user access (should succeed) ==="
su -s /bin/sh bob   -c 'cat /srv/shared/probe/alice.txt; echo x >> /srv/shared/probe/alice.txt' && echo "bob->alice.txt OK"
su -s /bin/sh alice -c 'cat /srv/shared/probe/bob.txt;   echo x >> /srv/shared/probe/bob.txt'   && echo "alice->bob.txt OK"
echo "=== outsider access (should fail) ==="
for u in nobody daemon; do
  su -s /bin/sh $u -c 'ls /srv/shared/probe' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "FAIL: $u could list" || echo "OK: $u denied ($?)"
  su -s /bin/sh $u -c 'cat /srv/shared/probe/alice.txt' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "FAIL: $u could read" || echo "OK: $u read denied"
done
su -s /bin/sh nobody -c 'ls /srv/shared' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "FAIL: nobody listed /srv/shared" || echo "OK: nobody denied on /srv/shared"

bash: set -e

getfacl -p /srv/shared | grep -qx 'other::---' && echo "OK other ---"
getfacl -p /srv/shared | grep -qx 'default:other::---' && echo "OK default other ---"
getfacl -p /srv/shared | grep -qx 'default:mask::rwx' && echo "OK default mask rwx"
for e in 'user:alice:rwx' 'user:bob:rwx' 'group:research:rwx'; do
  getfacl -p /srv/shared | grep -qx "$e" && echo "OK $e"
  getfacl -p /srv/shared | grep -qx "default:$e" && echo "OK default:$e"
done
